correctness.rationale: On the 2^d dyadic atoms, P_S has equal absolute column sums by tree automorphisms. The common-prefix shell enumeration yields an exact binary-control norm sum_m |b_m-t_{m-1}|/2+t_d, t_m=(t_{m-1}+b_m)/2. Its Bellman recursion has V_1=1 and V_k(t)=a_k+c_k|t-1/2|; solving exact recurrences gives d/3+7/9+(-1)^d/(9*2^(d-1)). Strict affine branch comparisons prove the exact optimizer set, including d=1,2 boundaries. The independently constructed dyadic matrices gave identical values for all 126 masks through depth 6 and 65534 selector enumerations through depth 15.

value.rationale: The Haar system fails unconditionality at L1, and selecting whole frequency levels is a canonical family of endpoint suppression projections. The exact global constant for every finite depth, its parity-sensitive boundary term and every attaining selector constitute a complete natural finite-dimensional extremal problem with a closed Bellman structure. This gives precise logarithmic-depth growth rather than an arbitrary narrow invariant or routine recomputation.
